name: The Enchanted Glade
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.

When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.

If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
narrative.objectives: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, adventurer. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, adventurer, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 11 to 17, 3,120 XP in all.

quests.name: The Enchanted Glade
quests.objectiveText: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: Darkness in the Glade
quests.objectiveText: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: The Oracle Tree
quests.objectiveText: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.

quests.name: Teldrassil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Inscribed Bark to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Grove of the Ancients
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
